parsed.corrected_rationale: The comment expresses a broad motivational concern about the relevance of mirror descent and the $\ell_p$-norm for deep learning, mentioning "the one layer model considered in this paper and previous work" only as an illustrative example. It does not explicitly identify which section, table, figure, or unique aspect of the paper is being addressed, so the authors cannot confidently determine which part the comment targets. However, the comment clearly specifies what needs to be addressed: clarifying the role/implication of the $\ell_p$-norm and, if possible, highlighting a few practical mirror descent-based optimizers in the revision. Thus, the evidence fits the rubric level where the addressed part cannot be confidently determined but the requested change is clearly specified, rather than the level for a fully grounded comment.
